title: Uneraseable - CHAPTER 23: THE MAINTENANCE SHED THRESHOLD

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: Pierre examined the exhibit layout and display plaques, preparing to add an impressive discovery to the museum's collection.
critiques.comment: Repetitive start of lines and again tiny paragraphs

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "In Paris, we work with old stone every day," Pierre smiled smoothly.

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: Pierre stood quietly in the center of the emptying hall, Alfie watching from the cart, as the heavy security shutters began their slow, motorized descent.
